title: 第3章 妙手堂的雏形第4章 灵力流体力学
lines: 青云坊市东角，一条偏僻小巷尽头。
在林澈面前，这间铺面勉强能遮风挡雨，门楣上歪歪扭扭挂着“妙手堂”
三字的木牌在风中吱呀作响。
这里是一个被前主人用来堆放废弃丹炉和破烂药草的角落。
他花光了赵虎付的十块下品灵石把这地方租下。
“林兄弟，你真要在这里开医馆？”
赵虎扛着从废墟里扒出来的半扇木门，黝黑的脸上满是疑惑，嘀咕：“这地方连个正经修士都不愿来，旁边就是垃圾堆，灵气稀薄得跟凡人区似的。”
林澈正用削尖的木棍在地上画着什么，没抬头，语气平静：“灵气稀薄才好。
来的病人本就需要安静环境，况且——”
他直起身，指了指四周：“你看这格局，三面无窗，只有一扇门进出。
就算治疗过程中有灵力外泄，也不会惊扰到什么，比如坊市卫队。
对病人隐私也好。”
赵虎挠挠头，他一个炼气期体修，哪里懂这些弯弯绕绕。
不过既然林澈说了有用，他就信。
三天前要不是这位看着文弱的年轻人用几根树枝和一股巧劲，生生把他从走火入魔的边缘拉回来还助他突破筑基，他赵虎现在坟头草都该发芽了。
“行，你说啥就是啥！
我再去弄点木板来，把这破墙补补！”
看着赵虎风风火火跑出去的背影，林澈嘴角露出一丝苦笑。
三天了。
穿越到这个修真世界已经整整三天。
从乱葬岗爬出来时的惊悚情景还历历在目，那具被他解剖的铁甲兽尸体、那颗结构与恶性肿瘤惊人相似的“妖丹”
，以及右手在专注时浮现的半透明手术刀虚影……
一切都指向一个荒谬的事实：这个世界的所谓“修炼”
，很可能是一套极其精密的生物能量调控系统。
而所谓的走火入魔、经脉淤堵，不过是这套系统运行中出现的故障。
“那么，我算是什么？修真界的维修工？”
林澈自嘲地摇摇头，继续在地上画。
这是他根据记忆中的无菌室原理，用简陋材料布置的简易“净化阵”
，以特定角度摆放的碎灵石，配合他右手虚影引导的微弱灵力，能在小范围内过滤空气杂质。
刚画完最后一笔，门外传来嘈杂声。
“哟，这不是赵虎那夯货吗？怎么，被宗门赶出来后改行当木匠了？”
“让开，别挡道！”
林澈皱眉走出门，只见三个穿着青色道袍的年轻修士正拦在扛着木板的赵虎面前。
为首的是个尖嘴猴腮的瘦子，炼气七层修为，腰间挂着的玉牌上刻着“青阳”
二字。
青阳宗外门弟子。
赵虎脸色阴沉地问：“王顺，你有事？”
“没事就不能看看？”
王顺嗤笑着打量这间破铺面，“听说你找了个野路子大夫，把走火入魔治好了？还突破筑基了？骗鬼呢！
怕不是磕了什么禁药，回光返照吧！”
他身后两个跟班哄笑起来。
赵虎拳头捏得咯咯响，筑基期的气息隐隐波动。
王顺脸色微变，但嘴上依旧不饶人：“怎么，想动手？坊市规矩，筑基修士不得主动对炼气修士出手！

In the east corner of Qingyunfang City, at the end of a remote alley.
In front of Lin Che, this shop could barely keep out the wind and rain, and the word "Miaoshou Tang" hung crookedly on the lintel.
The three-character wooden sign creaked in the wind.
This is a corner used by the previous owner to store abandoned alchemy furnaces and tattered medicinal herbs.
He spent all the ten low-grade spiritual stones paid by Zhao Hu to rent this place.
"Brother Lin, do you really want to open a medical clinic here?"
Zhao Hu was carrying half of a wooden door that had been dug out of the ruins. His dark face was full of confusion and he muttered: "Not even a serious monk wants to come to this place. There is a garbage dump next to it, and the spiritual energy is as thin as the mortal area."
Lin Che was drawing something on the ground with a sharpened wooden stick. She didn't raise her head and said in a calm tone: "It's better if the spiritual energy is thin.
The patients who come here need a quiet environment, and besides—"
He straightened up and pointed around: "Look at this layout, there are no windows on three sides and only one door for entry and exit.
Even if spiritual power is leaked during the treatment, it will not disturb anyone, such as the city guards.
It’s also good for patient privacy. "
Zhao Hu scratched his head. He was a physical practitioner in the Qi refining period, so how could he understand these twists and turns.
But since Lin Che said it would be useful, he believed it.
Three days ago, if this weak-looking young man hadn't used a few branches and some clever energy to pull him back from the edge of obsession and help him break through the foundation, the grass on Zhao Hu's grave would have sprouted by now.
"Okay, whatever you say is what you say!
I'm going to get some more boards to mend this broken wall! "
Looking at Zhao Hu's back running away in a hurry, Lin Che showed a wry smile on her lips.
It's been three days.
It has been three full days since I traveled to this world of cultivation.
The horrifying scene when he climbed out of the mass grave is still vivid in his mind, the body of the armored beast that he dissected, and the "demon pill" whose structure was strikingly similar to that of a malignant tumor.
, and the translucent scalpel shadow that appears in the right hand when concentrating...
Everything points to an absurd fact: the so-called "cultivation" of this world
, is likely to be an extremely sophisticated biological energy control system.
The so-called obsession and blocked meridians are just failures in the operation of this system.
"So, who am I? A maintenance worker in the world of cultivation?"
Lin Che shook her head mockingly and continued drawing on the ground.
This is a simple "purification array" that he arranged using simple materials based on the principles of a sterile room in his memory.
, broken spiritual stones placed at a specific angle, combined with the weak spiritual power guided by the shadow of his right hand, can filter air impurities in a small area.
Just as he finished the last stroke, there was a noise outside the door.
"Hey, isn't this Zhao Hu's good guy? Why, he changed his profession to be a carpenter after being kicked out by the sect?"
"Get out of the way!"
Lin Che frowned and walked out, only to see three young monks wearing blue robes blocking Zhao Hu who was carrying a wooden board.
The leader is a thin man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks. He is at the seventh level of Qi refining. The jade plaque hanging around his waist is engraved with "Qingyang".
Two words.
An outer disciple of Qingyang Sect.
Zhao Hu asked with a gloomy face: "Wang Shun, what's wrong with you?"
"Can't you just take a look?"
Wang Shun sneered and looked at the shabby shop, "I heard that you found a wild doctor and cured your obsession? And you broke through the foundation building? What a liar!
I'm afraid I didn't take any forbidden drugs. Let's get back to our best! "
The two followers behind him burst into laughter.
Zhao Hu's fist clenched loudly, and the breath of the foundation-building stage fluctuated faintly.
Wang Shun's face changed slightly, but his words remained unforgiving: "What, you want to take action? According to the rules of the city, foundation-building monks are not allowed to take the initiative to take action against Qi-refining monks!
